- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.

## Current objective
Complete the `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` procedure for Acme. The dunning scheduler fix is superseded as the active objective; router split remains paused.

Request variable: `current_request_id`. Payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and shut down. Tenant: `REQ-2025-01842`; organization: `org_acme_industries`; schema: `0042`; billing customer: `cus_acme_2025`; currency: `USD`.

Pool size 50 caused staging contention/deadlocks. Wildcard imports hide missing names. Count/limit/offset pagination caused warnings. `print(invoice.id)` lacks request context. Do not change the legacy invoice-rounding fixture without separate review.

Created and migrated `org_acme_industries`, seeded roles/features/admin, and ensured its billing customer. Validated scheduler timezone behavior and focused tests.
